description: This file defines the EntityEcaCondition class, which represents a condition used in entity event condition actions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes logic for evaluating conditions, possibly invoking services, and managing comparison parameters.

classes.name: EntityEcaCondition
classes.description: Represents a condition for entity event actions, capable of evaluating itself based on entity data, service calls, and comparison parameters.

methods.name: EntityEcaCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition based on an XML element and flags indicating if it's a constant or service condition.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a given entity and context, possibly invoking a service or performing a comparison.

methods.name: getLValue
methods.description: Returns the left-hand side value name.

methods.name: getRValue
methods.description: Returns the right-hand side value or its string representation if constant.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the condition, including service name and parameters.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the condition's properties.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another EntityEcaCondition object.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns a list of field names involved in the condition.
